scope: Implementation composition roots, CLIs, readers, the governed runtime, Control Center, local pilot, experimental agent-runtime, and their readers and writers.
excluded_scope: Fresh host smoke tests, network access, browser execution, product or documentation fixes, real-store mutation, provider portability, and claims about universal host adoption.
executive_answer: The repository contains a federation rather than one runtime or one physical store. The reader process serves YAML and pending-sheet views plus a read-only Control Center; its runtime HTTP routes are present but closed. A separate governed runtime CLI remains directly reachable for trusted mutations, while loopback HTTP serving requires local-pilot preflight. Existing receipts and a changing live SQLite journal establish local operation, not production promotion. Authority is intentionally partitioned: the frozen corpus declares YAML authoritative for official dispatch opening and closing and declares the validated appender the intended sole physical writer, while the governed journal owns accepted runtime facts. The writer implementation itself is outside the frozen source manifest, so exclusivity is only partially proven. The independent agent-runtime package is implemented and tested but has no evidenced operational, authorized, or official cutover status.
property_served: One intelligible system boundary and one source of record per fact class, without collapsing implementation, proof, operation, authority, adoption, or reconstructibility.

claims.statement: implementations.server.main is the reader HTTP composition root: it reads ledgers and pending sheets, writes only confirmation markers, and publishes six Control Center query routes when interface bindings are complete. The reachable backend Control Center is read-only; LocalControlCenterStore is constructed but never called by the service or API, while reachable mutable UI preferences and drafts use browser localStorage.
